manuals.title: DeltaV Distributed Control System Reference Manual

content.title: DeltaV System Overview
content.content: DeltaV is a distributed control system for process industries. Architecture: controllers (MX, PK, SX), I/O cards (CHARMs, traditional), workstations, servers, network. DeltaV Live: HTML5 web interface. DeltaV SIS: separate safety system (SIL 3). Integrated historian, batch, advanced control. Cybersecurity: DeltaV Secure.

content.title: Controller Platform
content.content: MX Controller: high-capacity, redundancy (hot standby), 4000 I/O per pair. PK Controller: process, 1600 I/O. SX Controller: small systems, 400 I/O. All: function blocks (Control, Logic, Arithmetic, Signal Processing), sequential function charts, custom algorithms (C/C++). Deterministic scan: 100ms-1s.

content.title: CHARMs I/O
content.content: Characterization Module (CHARM): one per field device. Universal I/O: AI, AO, DI, DO, HART, pulse, RTD, TC. Electronic marshalling: software-defined wiring. HART pass-through. Intrinsically safe options. Hot-swappable. Reduces wiring by 50%. Auto-discovery.

content.title: DeltaV Live (HTML5 Interface)
content.content: Web-based operations interface. No client install. Responsive design. Graphics: SVGs, situational awareness. Faceplates: standard, custom. Alarm management: ISA-18.2. Trends, historian integration. Mobile: iOS/Android app. Authentication: Windows, LDAP, SAML. Role-based access.

content.title: DeltaV SIS (Safety Instrumented System)
content.content: Separate safety architecture. SLS 1508 controller (SIL 3). SISnet protocol (deterministic, redundant). SIF: Safety Instrumented Functions. Proof testing wizard. Bypass management. Integration with DeltaV for alarms, events, historian. Partial stroke testing. SIL verification.

content.title: DeltaV Batch
content.content: ISA-88 compliant batch management. Recipe: procedures, unit procedures, operations, phases. Equipment model: units, equipment modules, control modules. Recipe editor: graphical (SFC-based). Execution: promoter, operator prompts, electronic signatures. Material tracking. Integration with MES/ERP.

content.title: Advanced Control (MPC)
content.content: DeltaV PredictPro: Model Predictive Control. Dynamic matrix control (DMC). Constraint handling: manipulated, controlled, auxiliary. Adaptive models. Integration with DeltaV controls. Configuration: Identify, Test, Implement, Monitor. Applications: distillation, reactor, FCC, blending.

content.title: DeltaV Cybersecurity
content.content: DeltaV Secure: whitelisting, patch management, antivirus, backup, audit. Defense-in-depth: network segmentation, firewalls, DMZ. IEC 62443 compliance. User authentication: Windows, PKI, smart cards. Privilege management. Security zones. Incident response. Patch validation on test system.

content.title: Experion PKS Overview
content.content: Process Knowledge System (PKS) for process automation. Architecture: C300 controller, FIM (Fieldbus Interface Module), LIM (Local I/O Module), Server, Station (HMI), Historian. Experion Station: unified operations interface. Safety Manager: SIL 3 separate system. APC: Advanced Process Control. Uniformance: integration platform.

content.title: C300 Controller
content.content: High-performance redundant controller. 1000+ function blocks. Control: PID, cascade, ratio, override, split-range. Logic: IEC 61131-3 (FBD, LD, ST, SFC). Redundancy: hot standby <1s switchover. Peer-to-peer communication. OPC UA server. Cybersecurity: signed firmware, secure boot.

content.title: Experion Station (HMI/SCADA)
content.content: Unified operations: process, safety, batch, APC, historian. HTML5 web client (Station Web). Situational awareness graphics. Alarm management: ISA-18.2, EEMUA 191. Faceplates: standard library, custom. Trends: real-time, historical, comparison. Reports: automatic, on-demand. Mobile: Station Mobile app.

content.title: Safety Manager
content.content: Separate safety system (SIL 3). TMR (Triple Modular Redundancy) or duplex. Safety logic: FBD, LD. SIF management. Proof test wizard. Bypass/override management. Integration: Experion Station for alarms, faceplates. Fieldbus: Safety Fieldbus (Honeywell), PROFIsafe. Partial stroke testing.

content.title: Uniformance Platform
content.content: Integration platform: historian (PHD), analytics, reporting, MES connectivity. PHD: high-performance time-series. Analytics: Golden Batch, PCA, anomaly detection. Reporting: automated, web-based. Connectors: PI, SQL, OPC, REST. Pharma: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.

content.title: CENTUM VP Overview
content.content: Integrated production control system. Architecture: FCN/FCJ (control), FCS (safety), FIO (I/O), Vnet/IP (plant network), HIS (historian), ENG (engineering station), OPS (operator station). ProSafe-RS: separate safety system. Exaopc: OPC server. Exapilot: HMI/SCADA. PRM: Plant Resource Manager (asset management).

content.title: FCN/FCJ Controllers
content.content: FCN-RTU: field controller. FCN-DCS: DCS controller. FCJ: high-performance. Function blocks: control, logic, sequence, arithmetic. Redundancy: hot standby (FCN), TMR (FCJ). Vnet/IP: dual redundant Ethernet. Scan: 100ms-1s. Online download. Capacity: 10,000 blocks (FCJ).

content.title: ProSafe-RS (Safety System)
content.content: Separate safety architecture (SIL 3). TMR controllers. Safety logic: FBD, SFC. Vnet/IP safety network. Integration with CENTUM VP: shared engineering, unified HMI. Proof testing. Bypass management. Partial stroke testing. Field devices: PROFIsafe, HART safety.

content.title: Exapilot HMI/SCADA
content.content: Web-based operator interface. Graphics: vector, situational awareness. Alarm: ISA-18.2, EEMUA 191. Faceplates: standard, custom. Trends: real-time, historical. Reports. Mobile: Exapilot Mobile. Security: Windows, LDAP, SAML. Redundancy: hot standby servers.

content.title: PRM (Plant Resource Manager)
content.content: Asset management: device configuration, diagnostics, calibration, maintenance. HART, FOUNDATION Fieldbus, PROFIBUS PA. Device DTMs. Calibration management. Maintenance scheduling. Integration with CMMS/EAM. Mobile: PRM Mobile. Cloud: PRM Cloud.

content.title: Product Overview
content.content: PanelView 5000 terminals are industrial operator interfaces with 7", 10", 12", and 15" widescreen displays. Capacitive multi-touch, 1280x800 resolution. Runs Windows 10 IoT Enterprise. FactoryTalk View Site Edition (SE) runtime pre-installed. Dual EtherNet/IP ports with switch. No moving parts (fanless).

content.title: FactoryTalk View SE Runtime
content.content: Full-featured HMI/SCADA runtime. Features: vector graphics, faceplates, parameterized displays, alarm & event server, historical trending, recipes, security (Windows/FT), redundancy, VNC remote access. Supports 150+ drivers for PLC connectivity. Tag-based architecture with direct controller tag browsing.

subsections.title: Display Types
subsections.content: Base displays, popup displays, faceplates (reusable parametric), global objects. Animation: visibility, color, position, rotation, fill, text. VBA scripting for complex logic. State-based visibility for security.

subsections.title: Alarm & Event System
subsections.content: Server-based alarming with acknowledgment, shelving, escalation. Alarm areas for organization. Rich alarm attributes: priority, category, help URL, custom fields. Alarm banner, summary, history displays. Email/SMS notification via FactoryTalk Notification.

content.title: PLC Connectivity
content.content: Direct tag browsing for ControlLogix/CompactLogix (EtherNet/IP). Supports: MicroLogix, SLC, PLC-5 via drivers. Tag substitution for scalable displays. Data logging to local SQL Express or remote SQL Server. Recipe management with PLC tag synchronization.

content.title: Security & User Management
content.content: Integrated with FactoryTalk Security. Windows authentication or FT Directory. Roles: Operator, Maintenance, Engineer, Administrator. Area-based security for displays. Electronic signatures for critical actions (21 CFR Part 11). Audit trail for all operator actions.

content.title: Remote Access & Mobility
content.content: Built-in VNC server for remote desktop. FactoryTalk ViewPoint for web/mobile access (HTML5). Mobile app for iOS/Android. Remote expert assistance with screen sharing. Secure connectivity via FactoryTalk Remote Access (VPN).

content.title: Installation & Maintenance
content.content: Panel cutout dimensions: 7" (172x112mm), 10" (258x168mm), 12" (306x198mm), 15" (368x238mm). IP66 front, IP20 rear. Operating temp: 0-55°C. DC power (18-32 VDC). SD card for backup/restore. Factory reset via hardware button.

content.title: TP1500 Comfort Overview
content.content: 15.6" widescreen multi-touch (capacitive), 1366x768 resolution. Windows 10 IoT Enterprise LTSC. WinCC Unified PC Runtime pre-installed. 2x PROFINET (IRT), 2x USB, 1x SD, 1x DisplayPort. Fanless, IP65 front. Extended temperature: 0-50°C.

content.title: WinCC Unified System
content.content: Next-gen visualization in TIA Portal. Web-based (HTML5/JS/CSS3) - runs in any modern browser. Unified engineering for panels, PC, web. Features: faceplates, screen window, user administration, alarms, logging, recipes, reports. Client-server architecture. High-performance graphics with SVG.

subsections.title: Faceplates & Types
subsections.content: Reusable typed faceplates with interface parameters. Inheritance and composition. Dynamic faceplate instances. Faceplate types in project library. Versioning and change management.

subsections.title: JavaScript Scripting
subsections.content: Client-side and server-side JavaScript. Access to tags, alarms, logs, recipes via API. Async/await support. Custom widgets via Web Components. Debugging in browser DevTools.

content.title: Connectivity & Communication
content.content: Native S7 protocol (optimized block access). OPC UA client/server (DA/HA/AC). MQTT client for IoT. HTTP/REST API for third-party. PROFINET IO Device for HMI as device. Shared device for multiple controllers. S7 routing through HMI.

content.title: Edge Computing
content.content: WinCC Unified PC Runtime on same hardware. Edge apps via Docker containers. Siemens Industrial Edge integration. Data preprocessing, analytics, ML inference at edge. Secure connectivity to cloud (MindSphere, Azure, AWS).

content.title: Security Hardening
content.content: Secure boot, TPM 2.0, BitLocker encryption. User management: local, LDAP, RADIUS. Role-based access control (RBAC). Communication: HTTPS, OPC UA security, certificate management. Audit trail, electronic signature. Compliance: IEC 62443, ISA/IEC 62443-4-2.

manuals.title: Magelis GT/GTU Series Advanced HMI Manual

content.title: Magelis GT Advanced Overview
content.content: Advanced HMIs with 5.7" to 15" displays. Resistive touch (GT) or capacitive multi-touch (GTU). Windows Embedded Compact 7. Vijeo Designer runtime. Video input (1 channel composite/HDMI). 2x Ethernet, 2x USB, SD card, CFast. Fanless, IP66 front.

content.title: Vijeo Designer Software
content.content: HMI development environment. Features: vector graphics, animations, scripts (JavaScript/VB), recipes, alarms, trends, reports. Multi-language with runtime switching. Project simulation on PC. Version control integration. Library of 4000+ symbols.

content.title: Video Integration
content.content: Single video input (NTSC/PAL/HDMI). Display camera feeds on HMI. Picture-in-picture, full-screen, quad view. Snapshot to SD card. Motion detection trigger. Supports IP cameras via Ethernet (MJPEG/H.264). Recording to local storage.

content.title: System Overview
content.content: The ControlLogix 5000 series is a high-performance modular PLC platform designed for complex automation applications. It supports up to 32,000 I/O points, 100+ communication modules, and integrated motion control. The platform uses a common control engine across all controllers, enabling seamless migration and code reuse.

content.title: Hardware Architecture
content.content: The ControlLogix chassis uses a high-speed backplane (1.5 Gbps) supporting up to 17 slots. Controllers (1756-L7x/L8x) feature dual-core processors, 4-80 MB user memory, and integrated EtherNet/IP ports. I/O modules are hot-swappable with electronic keying. Redundancy modules (1756-RM2) provide bumpless failover.

subsections.title: Chassis Types
subsections.content: Available chassis: 1756-A4 (4-slot), 1756-A7 (7-slot), 1756-A10 (10-slot), 1756-A13 (13-slot), 1756-A17 (17-slot). All support standard and controlled environment ratings.

subsections.title: Controller Comparison
subsections.content: 1756-L71 (2MB), L72 (4MB), L73 (8MB), L74 (16MB), L75 (32MB) - 5570 series. 1756-L81E (4MB), L82E (8MB), L83E (16MB), L84E (32MB), L85E (80MB) - 5580 series with integrated safety.

content.title: Supported Programming Languages
content.content: ControlLogix supports four IEC 61131-3 languages: Ladder Diagram (LD), Structured Text (ST), Function Block Diagram (FBD), and Sequential Function Chart (SFC). Also supports C/C++ via the Open Development Kit (ODK) for custom algorithms.

subsections.title: Ladder Diagram (LD)
subsections.content: Primary language for boolean logic. Supports branches, subroutines, AOI (Add-On Instructions), and online editing. Use XIC, XIO, OTE, OTL, OTU, TON, TOF, RTO, CTU, CTD, RES instructions.

subsections.title: Structured Text (ST)
subsections.content: Pascal-like language for complex math, string handling, and algorithms. Supports IF-THEN-ELSE, CASE, FOR, WHILE, REPEAT loops. Ideal for recipes, data manipulation, and motion profiles.

content.title: Communication Protocols
content.content: Native EtherNet/IP (CIP) on controller. Supports DeviceNet, ControlNet, DH+, Remote I/O via communication modules. CIP Motion, CIP Safety, CIP Sync for time synchronization. OPC UA server built-in (5580 series).

content.title: Integrated Motion Control
content.content: CIP Motion supports up to 100 axes per controller. Supports servo, stepper, and induction motors. Features: electronic gearing, camming, position capture, coordinated motion (linear/circular interpolation), safety-rated monitored stop.

content.title: Integrated Safety (GuardLogix)
content.content: 5580 series controllers (L8xE) include SIL 3 / PLe safety. Separate safety memory, safety task, and safety I/O. Safety instructions: E-stop, guard monitoring, safety mat, two-hand control, speed monitoring. Safety signature for validation.

content.title: Troubleshooting & Diagnostics
content.content: Controller status indicators: RUN (green), I/O (green), FORCE (amber), FAULT (red). Major faults: Type 01-0F (hardware), Type 10-1F (I/O), Type 20-2F (communication), Type 30-3F (program). Use GSV/SSV for system values. Fault routine executes on major faults.

content.title: Best Practices
content.content: Use AOIs for reusable code. Organize with programs/routines. Use UDTs for structured data. Enable keying on I/O modules. Document with rung comments. Version control with Studio 5000 project files. Regular backup with .ACD files.

content.title: System Overview
content.content: The S7-1500 is Siemens' high-end modular controller for demanding automation tasks. Features: up to 20 MB program memory, 1 ns bit processing, integrated PROFINET (2-port switch), web server, OPC UA server, display, and SIMATIC memory card. Scalable from compact to high-performance CPUs.

content.title: CPU Portfolio
content.content: Standard CPUs: 1511-1 PN (150 KB), 1513-1 PN (300 KB), 1515-2 PN (500 KB), 1516-3 PN/DP (1 MB), 1517-3 PN/DP (2 MB), 1518-4 PN/DP (4 MB). Compact CPUs: 1511C, 1512C with onboard I/O. Technology CPUs: 1511T, 1515T, 1517T with motion control. F-CPU variants for safety (SIL 3).

content.title: TIA Portal Engineering
content.content: Total Integrated Automation Portal for unified engineering. Hardware configuration, programming (LAD, FBD, STL, SCL, GRAPH), diagnostics, commissioning. Multi-user engineering, version control integration, libraries, hardware detection.

content.title: PROFINET Communication
content.content: Integrated 2-port PROFINET switch (RT/IRT). Supports: IO Controller, IO Device, I-Device, Media Redundancy Protocol (MRP), Shared Device, Isochronous Real Time (IRT) for motion. Up to 256 IO Devices. Topology: line, star, ring.

content.title: Integrated Web Server
content.content: Access via standard browser (HTTP/HTTPS). Features: CPU status, diagnostics buffer, module info, firmware update, file browser, user pages (HTML/JavaScript), watch tables, trace. Custom web applications via Web API. Authentication: user management with roles.

content.title: OPC UA Server
content.content: Built-in OPC UA server (DA/HA/AC). Companion specifications: ADI, Robotics, PackML. Security: certificates, signing, encryption. Information modeling with nodesets. Alarms & Conditions, Historical Access, PubSub. Performance: up to 10,000 monitored items.

content.title: Technology Objects & Motion Control
content.content: Technology objects: positioning axis, synchronous axis, external encoder, measuring input, output cam, cam track. PLCopen Motion Control instructions (MC_Power, MC_MoveAbsolute, MC_GearIn, MC_CamIn). Up to 128 axes (CPU dependent). Kinematics for robots.

content.title: Safety Integrated (F-CPU)
content.content: Fail-safe CPUs up to SIL 3 (IEC 61508) / PL e (ISO 13849). Safety program in separate memory area. PROFIsafe for distributed safety I/O. Safety instructions: ESTOP, Two-Hand, Safety Door, Light Curtain, Muting, Speed Monitoring. Safety administration: password, validation, CRC.

content.title: M580 ePAC Overview
content.content: The Modicon M580 is an Ethernet PAC (Programmable Automation Controller) with unified Ethernet backbone. Features: dual-core CPU, 16-64 MB memory, integrated Ethernet switch, cybersecurity (Achilles Level 2), hot standby redundancy, 4000+ I/O. Programmed with Unity Pro / EcoStruxure Control Expert.

content.title: Ethernet Architecture
content.content: Single Ethernet network for I/O, HMI, SCADA, IT. RSTP ring topology (<50ms recovery). DIO (Distributed I/O) via EtherNet/IP and Modbus TCP. CIP Safety for safety I/O. QoS for traffic prioritization. Network Time Protocol (NTP) synchronization.

content.title: Hot Standby Redundancy
content.content: Primary/Standby CPU pair with automatic switchover (<50ms). Shared memory for state synchronization. Redundant Ethernet modules (BMEH582040). Supports: bumpless transfer, configuration sync, online modification. Requires: matched CPUs, same firmware, redundant power supplies.

content.title: Unity Pro / EcoStruxure Control Expert
content.content: IEC 61131-3 languages: Ladder (LD), Structured Text (ST), Function Block (FBD), Instruction List (IL), Sequential Function Chart (SFC). Advanced: DFBs (Derived Function Blocks), EFBs (Elementary Function Blocks), DDTs (Derived Data Types). Features: simulation, online changes, cross-references, documentation generator.

content.title: Cybersecurity Features
content.content: Achilles Level 2 certified. Features: signed firmware, secure boot, port disabling, IP filtering, user authentication (local/RADIUS/LDAP), role-based access (RBAC), audit logging, encrypted communication (TLS), certificate management. Compliance: IEC 62443, NERC CIP.

content.title: Integrated Safety
content.content: M580 Safety (BMEP58xx040) with SIL 3 / PL e. Separate safety CPU core. Safety I/O via CIP Safety on Ethernet. Safety programming in Unity Pro with safety library. Safety functions: E-stop, guard monitoring, safety mat, two-hand, speed/position monitoring. Safety signature and validation.

content.title: Platform Overview
content.content: Ignition is a cross-platform SCADA system built on Java. Unlimited licensing model (tags, clients, servers). Modules: Perspective (web), Vision (desktop), Tag Historian, Alarm Notification, Reporting, OPC UA, MQTT Engine, Device Drivers. Runs on Windows, Linux, macOS. Docker/Kubernetes deployment ready.

content.title: System Architecture
content.content: Gateway (central server) + Designer (development) + Clients (Perspective/Vision/Mobile). Gateway: web server (Jetty), servlet container, tag providers, alarm pipelines, historian, device connections. Clustering for HA/load balancing. Gateway backup/restore (.gwbk). Module system for extensibility.

content.title: Perspective Module (Web/Mobile)
content.content: React-based web framework for modern HMIs. Runs in browser (no client install). Responsive design (mobile/desktop/tablet). Components: charts, tables, maps, gauges, input. Session management, authentication (IdP/SAML/OIDC). Offline mode with service workers. WebSockets for real-time updates.

subsections.title: Views & Layouts
subsections.content: Coordinate, flex, breakpoint, column, tab containers. View parameters for reusable views. Navigation: tabs, menus, drawer, breadcrumbs. Popups, docked views. URL-based deep linking. Browser history integration.

subsections.title: Property Binding System
subsections.content: Declarative bindings: tag, expression, transform, script. Transforms: map, format, script, expression. Structure bindings for arrays/objects. Bidirectional bindings for input. Polling vs subscription modes.

content.title: Tag System & Historian
content.content: Unified tag model: OPC, memory, expression, query, UDT. UDTs with inheritance, parameters, overrides. Tag historian: partitioned storage, compression, aggregation. SQL backend (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, SQLite). Tag groups for scan classes. Derived tags.

content.title: Alarm Notification
content.content: Alarm pipelines with drop-down design. Notification profiles: email, SMS, voice, push, webhook. Escalation, acknowledgment, shelving. Alarm shelving with auto-unshelve. Alarm history with query API. ISA-18.2 compliance features.

content.title: MQTT Engine & Sparkplug B
content.content: Native MQTT broker (Mosquitto) or external. Sparkplug B spec for state management. Edge-of-network nodes, devices, metrics. Birth/death certificates. Tag provider integration. MQTT Transmission for store-and-forward. TLS authentication.

content.title: Deployment & DevOps
content.content: Docker images (official). Kubernetes Helm charts. Gateway backup/restore automation. Project export/import (.zip). Git integration for projects. CI/CD pipelines. Blue-green deployments. Gateway network for multi-site.

content.title: System Platform Overview
content.content: Industrial software platform with ArchestrA object-based architecture. Components: Galaxy (object repository), InTouch (HMI/SCADA), Historian, MES, Communication Drivers. Single namespace for all objects. .NET-based with COM interop. Windows Server deployment.

content.title: ArchestrA IDE & Object Model
content.content: Object-oriented automation: templates, instances, inheritance, containment. Graphic symbols linked to objects. Scripting: C#/.NET in ArchestrA IDE. Attributes: intrinsic, custom, reference. Alarm/Event integration. Security model with areas, roles, users.

content.title: InTouch HMI/SCADA
content.content: Situational awareness graphics (high-performance). Symbol library with Situational Awareness Library. Trending, alarming, reporting built-in. Web Client for browser access. Mobile app. QuickScript for logic. Window management: replace, overlay, popup, tile.

content.title: AVEVA Historian
content.content: High-performance time-series database. Compression: swinging door, Box-Car. Collection: unsolicited, polled, calculated. Retrieval: raw, interpolated, aggregated (avg, min, max, count). OPC HDA server. Redundancy. Integration with PI System.

content.title: Deployment Server & Galaxy
content.content: Centralized deployment: Galaxy repository, Deployment Server, Console. Version control for objects. Check-in/check-out. Remote deployment to nodes. Rollback capability. Disaster recovery. Multi-site Galaxy replication.

content.title: VTScada Overview
content.content: Tag-based SCADA with integrated historian, alarming, reporting. Single executable (~100MB). No SQL database required (built-in historian). Unlimited tags/clients licensing. Runs on Windows. Web Client (HTML5), Mobile app. Hot redundancy. PLC drivers: 150+ protocols.

content.title: Tag System
content.content: Tag types: analog, digital, string, array, structure. Tag properties: scaling, alarming, logging, security, scripting. Tag groups for scan rates. Derived tags with expressions. Tag import/export (CSV, Excel). Online tag browsing for supported drivers.

content.title: Application Development
content.content: Pages: graphics, trends, alarms, reports. Widgets: 200+ built-in. Scripting: VBScript, JavaScript, Python. Faceplates with parameters. Multi-language (runtime switching). Security: 32 levels, area-based. Version control integration.

content.title: Integrated Historian
content.content: Proprietary time-series database. Compression algorithms. Automatic partitioning. Retention policies. Fast retrieval: raw, calculated. Historian tags auto-configured. Redundancy with sync. Export to CSV/Excel. OPC HDA not required.

content.title: IoT & Cloud Integration
content.content: MQTT client (publisher/subscriber). Sparkplug B support. REST API for tag read/write. Cloud connectors: AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud. Edge gateway for store-and-forward. OPC UA server/client. Data historian replication to cloud.

content.title: IO-Link System Overview
content.content: IO-Link: point-to-point communication (IEC 61131-9). Master connects to PLC via fieldbus (PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT). Up to 8 ports per master. Sensors/actuators with IO-Link interface. Parameter server for automatic backup/restore. LR DEVICE for device description (IODD). LR AGENT for master configuration.

content.title: Master Types
content.content: Compact: AL1100 (4-port, IP67), AL1120 (8-port, IP67). Cabinet: AL1140 (8-port, IP20), AL1300 (16-port, IP20). Fieldbus: PROFINET (IRT/RT), EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CC-Link IE Field. Power: Class A (24V), Class B (24V + actuator supply). Diagnostics: per-port LED, web server, JSON REST API.

content.title: Smart Sensor Portfolio
content.content: Position: inductive, capacitive, magnetic, photoelectric. Process: pressure, temperature, flow, level. Identification: RFID, 1D/2D code readers. Condition monitoring: vibration, oil quality. All with IO-Link: parameterization, diagnostics, process data, events. IODD files for integration.

content.title: Parameter Server & Data Storage
content.content: Automatic parameter backup when device connected. Restore on device replacement (plug & play). Data storage index (0-3) for multiple configurations. Vendor-specific vs standard parameters. Block parameterization for commissioning. LR AGENT for bulk configuration.

content.title: moneo Software Suite
content.content: moneo|configure: parameter management, IODD library. moneo|monitor: real-time visualization, dashboards. moneo|analyze: historical analysis, reports. moneo|remote: secure remote access. Cloud or on-premise. Integration with IT systems via REST API, OPC UA, MQTT.

content.title: SICK Sensor Portfolio
content.content: Comprehensive industrial sensors: photoelectric, proximity, registration, distance, vision, LiDAR, RFID, safety. Communication: IO-Link, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, PROFIsafe, CIP Safety. Software: SOPAS ET (Engineering Tool), SICK AppSpace, SICK AppPool. Cloud: SICK Cloud Services.

content.title: Vision Sensors & Cameras
content.content: Inspector series: 2D vision (Inspector P, I, 83x). Lector series: code reading (1D/2D/DPM). Ranger: 3D vision. InspectorP: deep learning. Configuration: SOPAS ET, web server. Interface: EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, TCP/IP. Trigger: hardware, software, free-run. Output: results, images, statistics.

content.title: LiDAR Sensors
content.content: TiM series: 2D LiDAR (indoor/outdoor). LMS: industrial 2D. MRS: multi-layer 3D. OutdoorScan: long-range. Navigation, collision avoidance, area monitoring. Interface: Ethernet, CAN, USB. ROS driver. Safe variants (SIL 2/PL d). Configuration: SOPAS ET.

content.title: Safe Sensors & Systems
content.content: Safety light curtains (deTec, C4000). Safety laser scanners (S3000, microScan3). Safety switches (i100, i110). Safety controllers (Flexi Soft, FX3-CPU). PROFIsafe, CIP Safety, FSoE. Safety Designer for configuration. Safe networking via safety PLC or safety gateway.

content.title: SICK AppSpace & AppPool
content.content: AppSpace: develop custom sensor apps (C++, Python). Run on sensor (edge computing). AppPool: marketplace for pre-built apps. Apps for: quality inspection, logistics, robotics, condition monitoring. Deployment via SOPAS ET or cloud. Licensing per sensor/app.

manuals.title: Banner Engineering Sensor Catalog & Integration Guide
manuals.model: Q4X, Q3X, Q2X, R-GAGE, QS18, QS30 Series

content.title: Sensor Portfolio
content.content: Photoelectric: opposed, retro-reflective, diffuse, background suppression. Measurement: laser distance (Q4X, R-GAGE), ultrasonic, radar. Vision: iVu, VE series. Wireless: SureCross (900 MHz, 2.4 GHz). Safety: light curtains, E-stops. IO-Link on most models. Banner CDS (Configuration & Diagnostic Software).

content.title: Q4X Laser Distance Sensor
content.content: Time-of-flight laser: 300mm-10m (class 1), 300mm-50m (class 2). mm resolution. IO-Link, 4-20mA, NPN/PNP. Background suppression. Multi-segment display. Teach-in via button or IO-Link. Applications: positioning, level, loop control, web break detection. Temperature compensation.

content.title: Radar Sensors (R-GAGE)
content.content: FMCW radar: 24 GHz (ISM band). Range: 0.3-40m. Penetrates: rain, fog, dust, plastic, glass. IO-Link, CAN, Modbus. Configurable field of view. Multi-target tracking. Applications: vehicle detection, level (solids/liquids), collision avoidance, bulk solids. No moving parts.

content.title: SureCross Wireless
content.content: Industrial wireless I/O. Gateway (DX80) + Nodes (inputs/outputs). 900 MHz (long range) or 2.4 GHz (global). FHSS (frequency hopping). Range: up to 3km (900 MHz), 1km (2.4 GHz). Self-healing mesh. Battery life: years. Security: AES-128. Modbus/TCP, EtherNet/IP gateway.

content.title: Drive Overview
content.content: PowerFlex 755 is a high-performance AC drive (0.75-2000 HP). Features: integrated EtherNet/IP, DeviceLogix (embedded logic), Safe Torque Off (STO SIL 3), positioning/indexing, predictive diagnostics, automatic device configuration (ADC). Frame sizes 1-10. Input: 200-690V AC.

content.title: DeviceLogix Embedded Logic
content.content: Programmable logic inside the drive (no PLC needed). 50 function blocks: boolean, math, compare, timer, counter, latch, multiplexer. 1ms scan time. Access to drive parameters, I/O, network data. Programmed via DriveExplorer or CCW. Use for: local control, sequencing, protection logic, pump/ fan staging.

content.title: Integrated Safety
content.content: Safe Torque Off (STO) SIL 3/PLe standard. Optional: Safe Speed Monitor (SSM), Safe Stop 1 (SS1), Safe Brake Control (SBC), Safe Direction (SDI). Safety option module 20-750-S. Safety configuration via DriveExplorer. Safety signature. Reaction time: <10ms for STO.

content.title: Positioning & Indexing
content.content: Point-to-point positioning with encoder feedback. Modes: absolute, relative, registration, homing. Profile: trapezoidal, S-curve. Electronic gearing (follower ratio). Camming with profile tables. Encoder: incremental, absolute (Hiperface, EnDat, SSI). Position capture (latch).

content.title: Predictive Diagnostics
content.content: Drive health monitoring: heatsink temp, bus capacitor life, fan hours, bearing hours, IGBT thermal model. Remaining life estimation. Alarm thresholds configurable. Data logged to internal memory. Access via EtherNet/IP or web server. Integration with FactoryTalk Analytics.

content.title: Communication & Configuration
content.content: Dual-port EtherNet/IP (DLR, linear, star). Device Level Ring (DLR) for redundancy. Embedded web server for configuration. ADC (Automatic Device Configuration) from Logix controller. Parameter groups: motor, speed, torque, position, I/O, communication, safety, application.

content.title: G120 Overview
content.content: Modular drive system: Control Unit (CU) + Power Module (PM). Power range 0.37-250 kW. Control Units: CU250S-2 (EtherNet/IP), CU250S-2 DP (PROFIBUS), CU250S-2 PN (PROFINET). Safety Integrated: STO, SS1, SBC, SSM, SDI, SLS (SIL 2/PL d). Basic Positioner (EPos) included.

content.title: Startdrive Commissioning Tool
content.content: Integrated in TIA Portal. Wizard-based commissioning. Motor identification (rotating/standstill). Speed controller optimization. Safety commissioning with validation. Trace function for diagnostics. Parameter comparison. Offline/online modes. Project download/upload.

content.title: Safety Integrated
content.content: Functions: STO, SS1, SBC, SSM, SDI, SLS (up to 4 speed stages). Safe Brake Test. PROFIsafe via PROFINET/PROFIBUS. Safety parameters password-protected. Forced dormant error detection. Safety logbook. Acceptance test wizard with report generation.

content.title: Basic Positioner (EPos)
content.content: Positioning modes: absolute, relative, referencing, flying referencing, jog. Traversing blocks (up to 64). Traversing profiles: trapezoidal, S-curve. Jerk limitation. Direct setpoint specification (MDI). Modulo offset for rotary axes. Encoder: HTL/TTL, DRIVE-CLiQ, SSI.

content.title: Fieldbus Communication
content.content: PROFINET (IRT/RT), PROFIBUS DP, EtherNet/IP, CANopen, USS, Modbus RTU. Telegram selection (standard/safety). Shared device. Media Redundancy Protocol (MRP). Isochronous mode for motion. Web server for diagnostics. OPC UA server (CU250S-2 PN).

content.title: Altivar Process Overview
content.content: Process drives for pumps, fans, compressors (0.75-2500 kW). Services-oriented: energy monitoring, asset management, process optimization. Embedded Ethernet (dual port). Web server. Device Type Manager (DTM) for FDT frameworks. Cybersecurity: Achilles Level 2.

content.title: Embedded Services
content.content: Energy: consumption, efficiency, kWh, CO2. Asset: operating hours, starts, temperature, vibration. Process: flow, pressure, level control (PID). Pump: multi-pump staging, anti-jam, pipe fill, dry run. Fan: stall detection, filter monitoring. Compressor: load/unload, sequencing.

content.title: Device Type Manager (DTM)
content.content: FDT/DTM standard for configuration. Works with: EcoStruxure Control Expert, PACTware, FieldCare, other FDT frames. Online/offline parameterization. Diagnostics: oscilloscope, trending, alarm history. Firmware update via DTM. DTMs available for all Altivar models.

searchIndex.manualTitle: DeltaV Distributed Control System Reference Manual
searchIndex.sectionContent: DeltaV is a distributed control system for process industries. Architecture: controllers (MX, PK, SX), I/O cards (CHARMs, traditional), workstations, servers, network. DeltaV Live: HTML5 web interface. DeltaV SIS: separate safety system (SIL 3). Integrated historian, batch, advanced control. Cybersecurity: DeltaV Secure.

searchIndex.manualTitle: DeltaV Distributed Control System Reference Manual
searchIndex.sectionContent: MX Controller: high-capacity, redundancy (hot standby), 4000 I/O per pair. PK Controller: process, 1600 I/O. SX Controller: small systems, 400 I/O. All: function blocks (Control, Logic, Arithmetic, Signal Processing), sequential function charts, custom algorithms (C/C++). Deterministic scan: 100ms-1s.

searchIndex.manualTitle: DeltaV Distributed Control System Reference Manual
searchIndex.sectionContent: Characterization Module (CHARM): one per field device. Universal I/O: AI, AO, DI, DO, HART, pulse, RTD, TC. Electronic marshalling: software-defined wiring. HART pass-through. Intrinsically safe options. Hot-swappable. Reduces wiring by 50%. Auto-discovery.

searchIndex.manualTitle: DeltaV Distributed Control System Reference Manual
searchIndex.sectionContent: Web-based operations interface. No client install. Responsive design. Graphics: SVGs, situational awareness. Faceplates: standard, custom. Alarm management: ISA-18.2. Trends, historian integration. Mobile: iOS/Android app. Authentication: Windows, LDAP, SAML. Role-based access.

searchIndex.manualTitle: DeltaV Distributed Control System Reference Manual
searchIndex.sectionContent: Separate safety architecture. SLS 1508 controller (SIL 3). SISnet protocol (deterministic, redundant). SIF: Safety Instrumented Functions. Proof testing wizard. Bypass management. Integration with DeltaV for alarms, events, historian. Partial stroke testing. SIL verification.

searchIndex.manualTitle: DeltaV Distributed Control System Reference Manual
searchIndex.sectionContent: ISA-88 compliant batch management. Recipe: procedures, unit procedures, operations, phases. Equipment model: units, equipment modules, control modules. Recipe editor: graphical (SFC-based). Execution: promoter, operator prompts, electronic signatures. Material tracking. Integration with MES/ERP.

searchIndex.manualTitle: DeltaV Distributed Control System Reference Manual
searchIndex.sectionContent: DeltaV PredictPro: Model Predictive Control. Dynamic matrix control (DMC). Constraint handling: manipulated, controlled, auxiliary. Adaptive models. Integration with DeltaV controls. Configuration: Identify, Test, Implement, Monitor. Applications: distillation, reactor, FCC, blending.

searchIndex.manualTitle: DeltaV Distributed Control System Reference Manual
searchIndex.sectionContent: DeltaV Secure: whitelisting, patch management, antivirus, backup, audit. Defense-in-depth: network segmentation, firewalls, DMZ. IEC 62443 compliance. User authentication: Windows, PKI, smart cards. Privilege management. Security zones. Incident response. Patch validation on test system.

Process Knowledge System (PKS) for process automation. Architecture: C300 controller, FIM (Fieldbus Interface Module), LIM (Local I/O Module), Server, Station (HMI), Historian. Experion Station: unified operations interface. Safety Manager: SIL 3 separate system. APC: Advanced Process Control. Uniformance: integration platform.

High-performance redundant controller. 1000+ function blocks. Control: PID, cascade, ratio, override, split-range. Logic: IEC 61131-3 (FBD, LD, ST, SFC). Redundancy: hot standby <1s switchover. Peer-to-peer communication. OPC UA server. Cybersecurity: signed firmware, secure boot.

Unified operations: process, safety, batch, APC, historian. HTML5 web client (Station Web). Situational awareness graphics. Alarm management: ISA-18.2, EEMUA 191. Faceplates: standard library, custom. Trends: real-time, historical, comparison. Reports: automatic, on-demand. Mobile: Station Mobile app.

Separate safety system (SIL 3). TMR (Triple Modular Redundancy) or duplex. Safety logic: FBD, LD. SIF management. Proof test wizard. Bypass/override management. Integration: Experion Station for alarms, faceplates. Fieldbus: Safety Fieldbus (Honeywell), PROFIsafe. Partial stroke testing.

Integration platform: historian (PHD), analytics, reporting, MES connectivity. PHD: high-performance time-series. Analytics: Golden Batch, PCA, anomaly detection. Reporting: automated, web-based. Connectors: PI, SQL, OPC, REST. Pharma: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.

Integrated production control system. Architecture: FCN/FCJ (control), FCS (safety), FIO (I/O), Vnet/IP (plant network), HIS (historian), ENG (engineering station), OPS (operator station). ProSafe-RS: separate safety system. Exaopc: OPC server. Exapilot: HMI/SCADA. PRM: Plant Resource Manager (asset management).

FCN-RTU: field controller. FCN-DCS: DCS controller. FCJ: high-performance. Function blocks: control, logic, sequence, arithmetic. Redundancy: hot standby (FCN), TMR (FCJ). Vnet/IP: dual redundant Ethernet. Scan: 100ms-1s. Online download. Capacity: 10,000 blocks (FCJ).

Separate safety architecture (SIL 3). TMR controllers. Safety logic: FBD, SFC. Vnet/IP safety network. Integration with CENTUM VP: shared engineering, unified HMI. Proof testing. Bypass management. Partial stroke testing. Field devices: PROFIsafe, HART safety.

Web-based operator interface. Graphics: vector, situational awareness. Alarm: ISA-18.2, EEMUA 191. Faceplates: standard, custom. Trends: real-time, historical. Reports. Mobile: Exapilot Mobile. Security: Windows, LDAP, SAML. Redundancy: hot standby servers.

Asset management: device configuration, diagnostics, calibration, maintenance. HART, FOUNDATION Fieldbus, PROFIBUS PA. Device DTMs. Calibration management. Maintenance scheduling. Integration with CMMS/EAM. Mobile: PRM Mobile. Cloud: PRM Cloud.

PanelView 5000 terminals are industrial operator interfaces with 7", 10", 12", and 15" widescreen displays. Capacitive multi-touch, 1280x800 resolution. Runs Windows 10 IoT Enterprise. FactoryTalk View Site Edition (SE) runtime pre-installed. Dual EtherNet/IP ports with switch. No moving parts (fanless).

Full-featured HMI/SCADA runtime. Features: vector graphics, faceplates, parameterized displays, alarm & event server, historical trending, recipes, security (Windows/FT), redundancy, VNC remote access. Supports 150+ drivers for PLC connectivity. Tag-based architecture with direct controller tag browsing.

Base displays, popup displays, faceplates (reusable parametric), global objects. Animation: visibility, color, position, rotation, fill, text. VBA scripting for complex logic. State-based visibility for security.

Server-based alarming with acknowledgment, shelving, escalation. Alarm areas for organization. Rich alarm attributes: priority, category, help URL, custom fields. Alarm banner, summary, history displays. Email/SMS notification via FactoryTalk Notification.

Direct tag browsing for ControlLogix/CompactLogix (EtherNet/IP). Supports: MicroLogix, SLC, PLC-5 via drivers. Tag substitution for scalable displays. Data logging to local SQL Express or remote SQL Server. Recipe management with PLC tag synchronization.

Integrated with FactoryTalk Security. Windows authentication or FT Directory. Roles: Operator, Maintenance, Engineer, Administrator. Area-based security for displays. Electronic signatures for critical actions (21 CFR Part 11). Audit trail for all operator actions.

Built-in VNC server for remote desktop. FactoryTalk ViewPoint for web/mobile access (HTML5). Mobile app for iOS/Android. Remote expert assistance with screen sharing. Secure connectivity via FactoryTalk Remote Access (VPN).

Panel cutout dimensions: 7" (172x112mm), 10" (258x168mm), 12" (306x198mm), 15" (368x238mm). IP66 front, IP20 rear. Operating temp: 0-55°C. DC power (18-32 VDC). SD card for backup/restore. Factory reset via hardware button.

15.6" widescreen multi-touch (capacitive), 1366x768 resolution. Windows 10 IoT Enterprise LTSC. WinCC Unified PC Runtime pre-installed. 2x PROFINET (IRT), 2x USB, 1x SD, 1x DisplayPort. Fanless, IP65 front. Extended temperature: 0-50°C.

Next-gen visualization in TIA Portal. Web-based (HTML5/JS/CSS3) - runs in any modern browser. Unified engineering for panels, PC, web. Features: faceplates, screen window, user administration, alarms, logging, recipes, reports. Client-server architecture. High-performance graphics with SVG.
Reusable typed faceplates with interface parameters. Inheritance and composition. Dynamic faceplate instances. Faceplate types in project library. Versioning and change management.
Client-side and server-side JavaScript. Access to tags, alarms, logs, recipes via API. Async/await support. Custom widgets via Web Components. Debugging in browser DevTools.

Native S7 protocol (optimized block access). OPC UA client/server (DA/HA/AC). MQTT client for IoT. HTTP/REST API for third-party. PROFINET IO Device for HMI as device. Shared device for multiple controllers. S7 routing through HMI.

WinCC Unified PC Runtime on same hardware. Edge apps via Docker containers. Siemens Industrial Edge integration. Data preprocessing, analytics, ML inference at edge. Secure connectivity to cloud (MindSphere, Azure, AWS).

Secure boot, TPM 2.0, BitLocker encryption. User management: local, LDAP, RADIUS. Role-based access control (RBAC). Communication: HTTPS, OPC UA security, certificate management. Audit trail, electronic signature. Compliance: IEC 62443, ISA/IEC 62443-4-2.

searchIndex.manualTitle: Magelis GT/GTU Series Advanced HMI Manual
searchIndex.sectionContent: Advanced HMIs with 5.7" to 15" displays. Resistive touch (GT) or capacitive multi-touch (GTU). Windows Embedded Compact 7. Vijeo Designer runtime. Video input (1 channel composite/HDMI). 2x Ethernet, 2x USB, SD card, CFast. Fanless, IP66 front.

searchIndex.manualTitle: Magelis GT/GTU Series Advanced HMI Manual
searchIndex.sectionContent: HMI development environment. Features: vector graphics, animations, scripts (JavaScript/VB), recipes, alarms, trends, reports. Multi-language with runtime switching. Project simulation on PC. Version control integration. Library of 4000+ symbols.

searchIndex.manualTitle: Magelis GT/GTU Series Advanced HMI Manual
searchIndex.sectionContent: Single video input (NTSC/PAL/HDMI). Display camera feeds on HMI. Picture-in-picture, full-screen, quad view. Snapshot to SD card. Motion detection trigger. Supports IP cameras via Ethernet (MJPEG/H.264). Recording to local storage.

The ControlLogix 5000 series is a high-performance modular PLC platform designed for complex automation applications. It supports up to 32,000 I/O points, 100+ communication modules, and integrated motion control. The platform uses a common control engine across all controllers, enabling seamless migration and code reuse.

The ControlLogix chassis uses a high-speed backplane (1.5 Gbps) supporting up to 17 slots. Controllers (1756-L7x/L8x) feature dual-core processors, 4-80 MB user memory, and integrated EtherNet/IP ports. I/O modules are hot-swappable with electronic keying. Redundancy modules (1756-RM2) provide bumpless failover.
Available chassis: 1756-A4 (4-slot), 1756-A7 (7-slot), 1756-A10 (10-slot), 1756-A13 (13-slot), 1756-A17 (17-slot). All support standard and controlled environment ratings.
1756-L71 (2MB), L72 (4MB), L73 (8MB), L74 (16MB), L75 (32MB) - 5570 series. 1756-L81E (4MB), L82E (8MB), L83E (16MB), L84E (32MB), L85E (80MB) - 5580 series with integrated safety.

ControlLogix supports four IEC 61131-3 languages: Ladder Diagram (LD), Structured Text (ST), Function Block Diagram (FBD), and Sequential Function Chart (SFC). Also supports C/C++ via the Open Development Kit (ODK) for custom algorithms.
Primary language for boolean logic. Supports branches, subroutines, AOI (Add-On Instructions), and online editing. Use XIC, XIO, OTE, OTL, OTU, TON, TOF, RTO, CTU, CTD, RES instructions.
Pascal-like language for complex math, string handling, and algorithms. Supports IF-THEN-ELSE, CASE, FOR, WHILE, REPEAT loops. Ideal for recipes, data manipulation, and motion profiles.

Native EtherNet/IP (CIP) on controller. Supports DeviceNet, ControlNet, DH+, Remote I/O via communication modules. CIP Motion, CIP Safety, CIP Sync for time synchronization. OPC UA server built-in (5580 series).

CIP Motion supports up to 100 axes per controller. Supports servo, stepper, and induction motors. Features: electronic gearing, camming, position capture, coordinated motion (linear/circular interpolation), safety-rated monitored stop.

5580 series controllers (L8xE) include SIL 3 / PLe safety. Separate safety memory, safety task, and safety I/O. Safety instructions: E-stop, guard monitoring, safety mat, two-hand control, speed monitoring. Safety signature for validation.

Controller status indicators: RUN (green), I/O (green), FORCE (amber), FAULT (red). Major faults: Type 01-0F (hardware), Type 10-1F (I/O), Type 20-2F (communication), Type 30-3F (program). Use GSV/SSV for system values. Fault routine executes on major faults.

Use AOIs for reusable code. Organize with programs/routines. Use UDTs for structured data. Enable keying on I/O modules. Document with rung comments. Version control with Studio 5000 project files. Regular backup with .ACD files.

The S7-1500 is Siemens' high-end modular controller for demanding automation tasks. Features: up to 20 MB program memory, 1 ns bit processing, integrated PROFINET (2-port switch), web server, OPC UA server, display, and SIMATIC memory card. Scalable from compact to high-performance CPUs.

Standard CPUs: 1511-1 PN (150 KB), 1513-1 PN (300 KB), 1515-2 PN (500 KB), 1516-3 PN/DP (1 MB), 1517-3 PN/DP (2 MB), 1518-4 PN/DP (4 MB). Compact CPUs: 1511C, 1512C with onboard I/O. Technology CPUs: 1511T, 1515T, 1517T with motion control. F-CPU variants for safety (SIL 3).

Total Integrated Automation Portal for unified engineering. Hardware configuration, programming (LAD, FBD, STL, SCL, GRAPH), diagnostics, commissioning. Multi-user engineering, version control integration, libraries, hardware detection.

Integrated 2-port PROFINET switch (RT/IRT). Supports: IO Controller, IO Device, I-Device, Media Redundancy Protocol (MRP), Shared Device, Isochronous Real Time (IRT) for motion. Up to 256 IO Devices. Topology: line, star, ring.

Access via standard browser (HTTP/HTTPS). Features: CPU status, diagnostics buffer, module info, firmware update, file browser, user pages (HTML/JavaScript), watch tables, trace. Custom web applications via Web API. Authentication: user management with roles.

Built-in OPC UA server (DA/HA/AC). Companion specifications: ADI, Robotics, PackML. Security: certificates, signing, encryption. Information modeling with nodesets. Alarms & Conditions, Historical Access, PubSub. Performance: up to 10,000 monitored items.

Technology objects: positioning axis, synchronous axis, external encoder, measuring input, output cam, cam track. PLCopen Motion Control instructions (MC_Power, MC_MoveAbsolute, MC_GearIn, MC_CamIn). Up to 128 axes (CPU dependent). Kinematics for robots.

Fail-safe CPUs up to SIL 3 (IEC 61508) / PL e (ISO 13849). Safety program in separate memory area. PROFIsafe for distributed safety I/O. Safety instructions: ESTOP, Two-Hand, Safety Door, Light Curtain, Muting, Speed Monitoring. Safety administration: password, validation, CRC.

The Modicon M580 is an Ethernet PAC (Programmable Automation Controller) with unified Ethernet backbone. Features: dual-core CPU, 16-64 MB memory, integrated Ethernet switch, cybersecurity (Achilles Level 2), hot standby redundancy, 4000+ I/O. Programmed with Unity Pro / EcoStruxure Control Expert.

Single Ethernet network for I/O, HMI, SCADA, IT. RSTP ring topology (<50ms recovery). DIO (Distributed I/O) via EtherNet/IP and Modbus TCP. CIP Safety for safety I/O. QoS for traffic prioritization. Network Time Protocol (NTP) synchronization.

Primary/Standby CPU pair with automatic switchover (<50ms). Shared memory for state synchronization. Redundant Ethernet modules (BMEH582040). Supports: bumpless transfer, configuration sync, online modification. Requires: matched CPUs, same firmware, redundant power supplies.

IEC 61131-3 languages: Ladder (LD), Structured Text (ST), Function Block (FBD), Instruction List (IL), Sequential Function Chart (SFC). Advanced: DFBs (Derived Function Blocks), EFBs (Elementary Function Blocks), DDTs (Derived Data Types). Features: simulation, online changes, cross-references, documentation generator.

Achilles Level 2 certified. Features: signed firmware, secure boot, port disabling, IP filtering, user authentication (local/RADIUS/LDAP), role-based access (RBAC), audit logging, encrypted communication (TLS), certificate management. Compliance: IEC 62443, NERC CIP.

M580 Safety (BMEP58xx040) with SIL 3 / PL e. Separate safety CPU core. Safety I/O via CIP Safety on Ethernet. Safety programming in Unity Pro with safety library. Safety functions: E-stop, guard monitoring, safety mat, two-hand, speed/position monitoring. Safety signature and validation.

Ignition is a cross-platform SCADA system built on Java. Unlimited licensing model (tags, clients, servers). Modules: Perspective (web), Vision (desktop), Tag Historian, Alarm Notification, Reporting, OPC UA, MQTT Engine, Device Drivers. Runs on Windows, Linux, macOS. Docker/Kubernetes deployment ready.

Gateway (central server) + Designer (development) + Clients (Perspective/Vision/Mobile). Gateway: web server (Jetty), servlet container, tag providers, alarm pipelines, historian, device connections. Clustering for HA/load balancing. Gateway backup/restore (.gwbk). Module system for extensibility.

React-based web framework for modern HMIs. Runs in browser (no client install). Responsive design (mobile/desktop/tablet). Components: charts, tables, maps, gauges, input. Session management, authentication (IdP/SAML/OIDC). Offline mode with service workers. WebSockets for real-time updates.

Coordinate, flex, breakpoint, column, tab containers. View parameters for reusable views. Navigation: tabs, menus, drawer, breadcrumbs. Popups, docked views. URL-based deep linking. Browser history integration.

Declarative bindings: tag, expression, transform, script. Transforms: map, format, script, expression. Structure bindings for arrays/objects. Bidirectional bindings for input. Polling vs subscription modes.

Unified tag model: OPC, memory, expression, query, UDT. UDTs with inheritance, parameters, overrides. Tag historian: partitioned storage, compression, aggregation. SQL backend (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, SQLite). Tag groups for scan classes. Derived tags.

Alarm pipelines with drop-down design. Notification profiles: email, SMS, voice, push, webhook. Escalation, acknowledgment, shelving. Alarm shelving with auto-unshelve. Alarm history with query API. ISA-18.2 compliance features.

Native MQTT broker (Mosquitto) or external. Sparkplug B spec for state management. Edge-of-network nodes, devices, metrics. Birth/death certificates. Tag provider integration. MQTT Transmission for store-and-forward. TLS authentication.

Docker images (official). Kubernetes Helm charts. Gateway backup/restore automation. Project export/import (.zip). Git integration for projects. CI/CD pipelines. Blue-green deployments. Gateway network for multi-site.

Industrial software platform with ArchestrA object-based architecture. Components: Galaxy (object repository), InTouch (HMI/SCADA), Historian, MES, Communication Drivers. Single namespace for all objects. .NET-based with COM interop. Windows Server deployment.

Object-oriented automation: templates, instances, inheritance, containment. Graphic symbols linked to objects. Scripting: C#/.NET in ArchestrA IDE. Attributes: intrinsic, custom, reference. Alarm/Event integration. Security model with areas, roles, users.

Situational awareness graphics (high-performance). Symbol library with Situational Awareness Library. Trending, alarming, reporting built-in. Web Client for browser access. Mobile app. QuickScript for logic. Window management: replace, overlay, popup, tile.

High-performance time-series database. Compression: swinging door, Box-Car. Collection: unsolicited, polled, calculated. Retrieval: raw, interpolated, aggregated (avg, min, max, count). OPC HDA server. Redundancy. Integration with PI System.

Centralized deployment: Galaxy repository, Deployment Server, Console. Version control for objects. Check-in/check-out. Remote deployment to nodes. Rollback capability. Disaster recovery. Multi-site Galaxy replication.

Tag-based SCADA with integrated historian, alarming, reporting. Single executable (~100MB). No SQL database required (built-in historian). Unlimited tags/clients licensing. Runs on Windows. Web Client (HTML5), Mobile app. Hot redundancy. PLC drivers: 150+ protocols.

Tag types: analog, digital, string, array, structure. Tag properties: scaling, alarming, logging, security, scripting. Tag groups for scan rates. Derived tags with expressions. Tag import/export (CSV, Excel). Online tag browsing for supported drivers.

Pages: graphics, trends, alarms, reports. Widgets: 200+ built-in. Scripting: VBScript, JavaScript, Python. Faceplates with parameters. Multi-language (runtime switching). Security: 32 levels, area-based. Version control integration.

Proprietary time-series database. Compression algorithms. Automatic partitioning. Retention policies. Fast retrieval: raw, calculated. Historian tags auto-configured. Redundancy with sync. Export to CSV/Excel. OPC HDA not required.

MQTT client (publisher/subscriber). Sparkplug B support. REST API for tag read/write. Cloud connectors: AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud. Edge gateway for store-and-forward. OPC UA server/client. Data historian replication to cloud.

IO-Link: point-to-point communication (IEC 61131-9). Master connects to PLC via fieldbus (PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT). Up to 8 ports per master. Sensors/actuators with IO-Link interface. Parameter server for automatic backup/restore. LR DEVICE for device description (IODD). LR AGENT for master configuration.

Compact: AL1100 (4-port, IP67), AL1120 (8-port, IP67). Cabinet: AL1140 (8-port, IP20), AL1300 (16-port, IP20). Fieldbus: PROFINET (IRT/RT), EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CC-Link IE Field. Power: Class A (24V), Class B (24V + actuator supply). Diagnostics: per-port LED, web server, JSON REST API.

Position: inductive, capacitive, magnetic, photoelectric. Process: pressure, temperature, flow, level. Identification: RFID, 1D/2D code readers. Condition monitoring: vibration, oil quality. All with IO-Link: parameterization, diagnostics, process data, events. IODD files for integration.

Automatic parameter backup when device connected. Restore on device replacement (plug & play). Data storage index (0-3) for multiple configurations. Vendor-specific vs standard parameters. Block parameterization for commissioning. LR AGENT for bulk configuration.

moneo|configure: parameter management, IODD library. moneo|monitor: real-time visualization, dashboards. moneo|analyze: historical analysis, reports. moneo|remote: secure remote access. Cloud or on-premise. Integration with IT systems via REST API, OPC UA, MQTT.

Comprehensive industrial sensors: photoelectric, proximity, registration, distance, vision, LiDAR, RFID, safety. Communication: IO-Link, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, PROFIsafe, CIP Safety. Software: SOPAS ET (Engineering Tool), SICK AppSpace, SICK AppPool. Cloud: SICK Cloud Services.

Inspector series: 2D vision (Inspector P, I, 83x). Lector series: code reading (1D/2D/DPM). Ranger: 3D vision. InspectorP: deep learning. Configuration: SOPAS ET, web server. Interface: EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, TCP/IP. Trigger: hardware, software, free-run. Output: results, images, statistics.

TiM series: 2D LiDAR (indoor/outdoor). LMS: industrial 2D. MRS: multi-layer 3D. OutdoorScan: long-range. Navigation, collision avoidance, area monitoring. Interface: Ethernet, CAN, USB. ROS driver. Safe variants (SIL 2/PL d). Configuration: SOPAS ET.

Safety light curtains (deTec, C4000). Safety laser scanners (S3000, microScan3). Safety switches (i100, i110). Safety controllers (Flexi Soft, FX3-CPU). PROFIsafe, CIP Safety, FSoE. Safety Designer for configuration. Safe networking via safety PLC or safety gateway.

AppSpace: develop custom sensor apps (C++, Python). Run on sensor (edge computing). AppPool: marketplace for pre-built apps. Apps for: quality inspection, logistics, robotics, condition monitoring. Deployment via SOPAS ET or cloud. Licensing per sensor/app.

searchIndex.sectionContent: Photoelectric: opposed, retro-reflective, diffuse, background suppression. Measurement: laser distance (Q4X, R-GAGE), ultrasonic, radar. Vision: iVu, VE series. Wireless: SureCross (900 MHz, 2.4 GHz). Safety: light curtains, E-stops. IO-Link on most models. Banner CDS (Configuration & Diagnostic Software).

searchIndex.model: Q4X, Q3X, Q2X, R-GAGE, QS18, QS30 Series
searchIndex.sectionContent: Time-of-flight laser: 300mm-10m (class 1), 300mm-50m (class 2). mm resolution. IO-Link, 4-20mA, NPN/PNP. Background suppression. Multi-segment display. Teach-in via button or IO-Link. Applications: positioning, level, loop control, web break detection. Temperature compensation.

searchIndex.manualTitle: Banner Engineering Sensor Catalog & Integration Guide
searchIndex.model: Q4X, Q3X, Q2X, R-GAGE, QS18, QS30 Series
searchIndex.sectionContent: FMCW radar: 24 GHz (ISM band). Range: 0.3-40m. Penetrates: rain, fog, dust, plastic, glass. IO-Link, CAN, Modbus. Configurable field of view. Multi-target tracking. Applications: vehicle detection, level (solids/liquids), collision avoidance, bulk solids. No moving parts.

searchIndex.manualTitle: Banner Engineering Sensor Catalog & Integration Guide

searchIndex.sectionContent: Industrial wireless I/O. Gateway (DX80) + Nodes (inputs/outputs). 900 MHz (long range) or 2.4 GHz (global). FHSS (frequency hopping). Range: up to 3km (900 MHz), 1km (2.4 GHz). Self-healing mesh. Battery life: years. Security: AES-128. Modbus/TCP, EtherNet/IP gateway.

PowerFlex 755 is a high-performance AC drive (0.75-2000 HP). Features: integrated EtherNet/IP, DeviceLogix (embedded logic), Safe Torque Off (STO SIL 3), positioning/indexing, predictive diagnostics, automatic device configuration (ADC). Frame sizes 1-10. Input: 200-690V AC.

Programmable logic inside the drive (no PLC needed). 50 function blocks: boolean, math, compare, timer, counter, latch, multiplexer. 1ms scan time. Access to drive parameters, I/O, network data. Programmed via DriveExplorer or CCW. Use for: local control, sequencing, protection logic, pump/ fan staging.

Safe Torque Off (STO) SIL 3/PLe standard. Optional: Safe Speed Monitor (SSM), Safe Stop 1 (SS1), Safe Brake Control (SBC), Safe Direction (SDI). Safety option module 20-750-S. Safety configuration via DriveExplorer. Safety signature. Reaction time: <10ms for STO.

Point-to-point positioning with encoder feedback. Modes: absolute, relative, registration, homing. Profile: trapezoidal, S-curve. Electronic gearing (follower ratio). Camming with profile tables. Encoder: incremental, absolute (Hiperface, EnDat, SSI). Position capture (latch).

Drive health monitoring: heatsink temp, bus capacitor life, fan hours, bearing hours, IGBT thermal model. Remaining life estimation. Alarm thresholds configurable. Data logged to internal memory. Access via EtherNet/IP or web server. Integration with FactoryTalk Analytics.

Dual-port EtherNet/IP (DLR, linear, star). Device Level Ring (DLR) for redundancy. Embedded web server for configuration. ADC (Automatic Device Configuration) from Logix controller. Parameter groups: motor, speed, torque, position, I/O, communication, safety, application.

Modular drive system: Control Unit (CU) + Power Module (PM). Power range 0.37-250 kW. Control Units: CU250S-2 (EtherNet/IP), CU250S-2 DP (PROFIBUS), CU250S-2 PN (PROFINET). Safety Integrated: STO, SS1, SBC, SSM, SDI, SLS (SIL 2/PL d). Basic Positioner (EPos) included.

Integrated in TIA Portal. Wizard-based commissioning. Motor identification (rotating/standstill). Speed controller optimization. Safety commissioning with validation. Trace function for diagnostics. Parameter comparison. Offline/online modes. Project download/upload.

Functions: STO, SS1, SBC, SSM, SDI, SLS (up to 4 speed stages). Safe Brake Test. PROFIsafe via PROFINET/PROFIBUS. Safety parameters password-protected. Forced dormant error detection. Safety logbook. Acceptance test wizard with report generation.

Positioning modes: absolute, relative, referencing, flying referencing, jog. Traversing blocks (up to 64). Traversing profiles: trapezoidal, S-curve. Jerk limitation. Direct setpoint specification (MDI). Modulo offset for rotary axes. Encoder: HTL/TTL, DRIVE-CLiQ, SSI.

PROFINET (IRT/RT), PROFIBUS DP, EtherNet/IP, CANopen, USS, Modbus RTU. Telegram selection (standard/safety). Shared device. Media Redundancy Protocol (MRP). Isochronous mode for motion. Web server for diagnostics. OPC UA server (CU250S-2 PN).

Process drives for pumps, fans, compressors (0.75-2500 kW). Services-oriented: energy monitoring, asset management, process optimization. Embedded Ethernet (dual port). Web server. Device Type Manager (DTM) for FDT frameworks. Cybersecurity: Achilles Level 2.

Energy: consumption, efficiency, kWh, CO2. Asset: operating hours, starts, temperature, vibration. Process: flow, pressure, level control (PID). Pump: multi-pump staging, anti-jam, pipe fill, dry run. Fan: stall detection, filter monitoring. Compressor: load/unload, sequencing.

FDT/DTM standard for configuration. Works with: EcoStruxure Control Expert, PACTware, FieldCare, other FDT frames. Online/offline parameterization. Diagnostics: oscilloscope, trending, alarm history. Firmware update via DTM. DTMs available for all Altivar models.
